name: 2026-11-17-sets-and-emd
registered: 2026-11-17, before any of the runs below started; the git commit that adds this file is the record
question: Does a seat-order-independent network (Deep Sets) or a distribution-aware card abstraction (k-means on CDFs, an earth mover's distance proxy) make a stronger 9-max tournament network than today's design?

nm33.abs: blueprint/out_pa200 (200/200/200, k-means on next-street strength CDFs, OCHS river; renumbered by mean strength)

common: from scratch, nm25's settings: --tourney --menu mtt --depths 10,25 --ante 1 --short 0.5 --no-open-limp --pg neurd --neurd-beta 4 --kl 0.3 --entropy 0.04 --pool reg,reg,tag,maniac,station --pool-share 0.5 --exploit-share 0.25 --exploit-reset 60 --chunks 4 --batch 16384 --lib blueprint/libbp7.so; stop at --max-hands 6e8; the averaged network is compared

primary.metric: duplicate match against the baseline in nm25's game, both directions: delta = (candidate vs 8 x nm31 - nm31 vs 8 x candidate) / 2, bb/100 of ICM equity, each candidate on its own abstraction
primary.estimator: the plain duplicate mean is the primary estimate; the control-variate estimator (value-baseline, physics-style) is reported beside it and used only if its bias check passes (it must agree with the plain mean on a copy-vs-copy match within its interval)
primary.correction: Holm at alpha 0.05 over the family (look-elsewhere)
primary.decision: a candidate is better if its Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 and delta > 0

secondary.exploiter: 30-minute exploiter against each run; reported, a candidate must not be worse than the baseline by more than 1 bb/100
secondary.sense: ninemax_sense.py and ninemax_postflop.py pass counts; reported only
secondary.copy_check: each run against copies of itself must read 0 within its interval

not_allowed: changing the deal count, the seed, the metric, the family or the decision rule after seeing results; re-running a comparison and keeping the better reading
